evaluation_paradigm.description: Offline training evaluation on frozen held-out test splits. Metrics are static and decouple training benchmarks from live single-patient inference.

sub_models.task: Binary diabetes risk prediction from clinical & physiological biomarkers

dataset.name: PIMA Indians Diabetes Database (National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases)

preprocessing: Physiological zero-value audit & replacement with NaN
sub_models.champion_model: Logistic Regression with balanced class weights (selected by 5-fold CV ROC-AUC: 0.8353)

sub_models.task: 5-Class ordinal grading of diabetic retinopathy from retinal fundus photographs

dataset.name: APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection & DDR Fundus Benchmark

sub_models.architecture: EfficientNet-B0 transfer learning with class-balanced sampling and ordinal loss penalty

sub_models.task: 9-Class dermatoscopy lesion classification & high-risk malignancy triage
sub_models.architecture: EfficientNet-B0 with focal loss favoring malignant/premalignant sensitivities

knowledge_graph.scope_notice: 81.82% indicates graph topological connectedness (36/44 nodes connected). It represents graph structural density, NOT diagnostic accuracy or empirical therapeutic correctness. Formal clinical rules are adapted from clinical guidelines (ADA, AAO, AAD).

reasoning_engine.non_causal_principle: The LLM explains ML outputs using KG associations as correlated risk factors and comorbid manifestations. It strictly avoids asserting direct causality from correlation.
